bestBets.overview: We kick off the day with a maiden over 1000m. Today could finally be the day for REDS EXPRESS at start 16. His last couple of starts have shown good improvement and he should be hard fit now. Expect he will settle around midfield and with some clear running late, can be hitting the line strongly. THE BUNCHA has a couple of trials under his belt now and his latest suggests he is ready to head to the races. Expect he will roll forward from barrier 5 and can give a good sight on debut. PHENOMENORM showed improvement when resuming last start and should only be fitter for that effort. Can continue to progress here and be right in the mix. ULTRASONIC didn?t show a whole lot on debut, but will only benefit from the race day experience. Drawn ideally in barrier 2 and expecting an improved showing.

raceTips.comment: Reds Express has shown enough ability in recent outings to make him a leading contender here, with his racing pattern likely to allow him to settle close enough to the speed. He looks suited by the conditions and should get every chance to build momentum before the turn. Phenomenorm has been racing consistently and possesses enough tactical speed to put himself into the race from the outset. He should appreciate a positive tempo and has the ability to finish strongly when produced at the right time. Congargo is another with claims after showing sound ability and a competitive attitude in recent starts. He can settle handy to the leaders and should be given every opportunity to make his presence felt late.

bestBets.overview: Looks hard to go past MR TADASHI in this field. Absolutely loves racing over this track and trip, winning three in a row here before another solid effort last start. Five weeks between runs should have him fresh and ready to fire and he looks the one they all have to beat. WINNING POINT was very strong to the line last start after getting a little too far back to mount a serious challenge. Expect he can settle a touch closer this time around and with some clear running late, can be hitting the line strongly. IT IS TO BE should be hard fit now and his best form is certainly good enough to put him right in the mix here. VALENTINE JOHN looks next best.

raceTips.comment: Mr Tadashi looks a strong chance after producing a series of solid performances and has the tactical speed to position himself prominently. He should be able to travel comfortably before being asked for the effort in the straight. Valentine John has plenty of upside and looks capable of making his presence felt with a cleaner passage. He has shown enough speed to settle within striking distance and can finish strongly. Winning Point continues to race competitively and brings a genuine finishing burst into this contest. He should appreciate being able to settle just off the leaders and conserve energy for the straight. It Is To Be has been honest in recent assignments and possesses enough ability to stay in contention for the placings with the right run.

bestBets.overview: NIKITA ZOU showed plenty of improvement last start to run a career best race. Looks to be heading in the right direction and with further improvement here, is more than capable of taking this out. HELLFIGHTER didn?t live up to the market expectation last start when finishing out of the numbers as a $1.75 favourite. The slight concern is how wet the track gets after not enjoying the heavy going last start, but deserves to be right in the mix here. BRILLIANT BULL ANT should be rock hard fit after a number of runs this prep. Generally gets back in his races and makes his own luck, but expect he can be hitting the line strongly late. EL COOL GEE looks next best.

raceTips.comment: Brilliant Bull Ant has been building a strong profile and looks suited by the way this race is likely to unfold. He possesses enough early speed to find a favourable position and should be able to travel comfortably before being asked for his effort. Nikita Zou has the ability to race prominently and should benefit from being able to control his own rhythm. Hellfighter remains an interesting runner with enough ability to be competitive if he gets the right tempo and can produce his finishing sprint when it matters.

bestBets.overview: SNITZEL TYCOON looks to be a progressive type after two strong efforts to kickstart her career. Looks to really embrace the heavy conditions and with plenty of rain predicted leading into race day, she should get conditions to suit again. Has shown plenty of gate speed and expect she will roll forward and be strong to the line. PETROULA was terrific here two runs back before being a little flat last start. Has shown enough ability to suggest she is better than that effort and happy to give her another chance here. MR BAZZA should only benefit from the first up effort and looks capable of improving second up. CERTAIN ECLIPSE can be in the mix first up.

raceTips.comment: Snitzel Tycoon brings a solid level of form into this contest and looks capable of settling in a position that allows him to travel comfortably throughout. He has shown enough speed and strength to make his presence felt when the pressure goes on. Mr Bazza is racing with consistency and should appreciate a race where he can settle just behind the leading runners. He has the ability to keep finding the line strongly. Pertroula has shown flashes of good ability and looks capable of improving with the right run in transit. She can settle closer to the speed and should have enough strength to remain competitive late.

bestBets.overview: CANNY HELL is lightly raced for a 6yo but has always shown plenty of promise. Looks to have returned in very good order after a dominant trial performance leading into this. Is a proven fresh performer and expect he can put in another strong showing here. KING GUTHO is always thereabouts and should be rock hard fit now after a number of runs this prep. His best is certainly good enough to put him right in the mix. RUBI AIR looks to get the gun run from the inside gate. Has been racing well of late and deserves to be considered a genuine contender here. LAUREL HILL is good enough at her best.

raceTips.comment: Canny Hell is well placed resuming over the 1200m and has performed strongly when fresh over his career, maps to enjoy a soft run stalking the leading pair throughout with the benefit of a 1.5kg claim. Laurel Hill hit the line strongly over 1400m in a higher grade race, now at peak fitness this preparation and will settle off the speed saved for one sprint at them late. Rubi Air & Struggle Street bring the required last start form into the race and with improvement between runs will both figure in the finish.

bestBets.overview: ROYALTOWN has had a very strong start to his career and looks to get the ideal run from the inside draw here. Strips fitter now third up and expect he will be in this for a long way. Plenty to like about him and looks a great chance. BLOW ON THE DICE has been racing in terrific form of late, highlighted by a dominant win last start. Looks to have really turned a corner this prep and we can have plenty of confidence in him putting in another strong showing. DESERT OPAL is flying after back to back wins and is more than capable of making it a hat trick here. Gets the benefit of the 1.5kg claim with the apprentice in the saddle and should be right in the mix again. VELIA looks next best.

raceTips.comment: Blow On The Dice has been racing in solid fashion and looks capable of taking advantage of a favourable position in the run. He possesses enough tactical speed to stay within striking distance and should have plenty of room to build through his gears. Desert Opal has shown good ability in recent outings and looks suited if able to find a comfortable rhythm near the speed. She should be able to conserve enough energy for a strong finish. Royaltown is an honest performer who continues to give a good account of himself and can be competitive again with the right passage. Vella has the ability to finish her races off strongly and should not be underestimated if she can settle within range. She has enough late strength to make her presence felt.

bestBets.overview: JUDITHS REVENGE is as honest as they come and loves racing here at her home track. Put together a long and consistent preparation last time in and was certainly deserving of a win. Looks a genuine contender in this field and expect another strong showing. CURLY BEND should be rock hard fit now and gets the ideal draw from the inside gate. If he can get back to his best, he is more than capable of being in the mix here. KOOL KADE put in a much improved performance second up when only overrun late. Will be fitter again from that effort and can continue to progress here. JUSTBETRYIN has been competitive of late and deserves consideration here.

raceTips.comment: Judith's Revenge is perfectly placed resuming over the 1200m and has performed strongly when fresh over her career, will settle off the speed and with a genuine early tempo will get every chance to finish over the top of them late. Riverband Unicorn hit the line strongly when winning over 1180m last start and would have taken considerable improvement off that performance, maps to enjoy a soft run just off the leading group and saved for one sprint at them late. Kool Kade brings the required last start form into the race and with improvement between runs will figure in the finish.

bestBets.overview: SERENADING resumes after 37 weeks and is currently unbeaten when first up. Has always shown plenty of gate speed and from barrier 2, expect he will roll forward and look to take up the lead. If he returns in similar order to last prep, looks the one to beat. INITIATE looks one the market may have missed early. Is a proven fresh performer and showed plenty of ability last prep. Expect he can be right in the thick of it here. SHES THE KEY put in a strong on pace effort first up and will only be fitter for that run. Expecting further improvement second up and she can be in this for a long way. DRAMA DODGER looks next best.

raceTips.comment: The consistent and lightly raced Serenading is perfectly placed resuming over the 1000m, drawn to enjoy the run of the race stalking the leading pair throughout and saved for one sprint at them late.
